description:
The CT Cranium DICOM dataset is loaded in InVesalius 3. A forensic anthropologist needs a 3D surface model of the external facial/cranial contour (soft tissue) for facial reconstruction. Your task is to: 
1. Create a segmentation mask that captures the skin surface (do NOT use the default Bone preset; use a Soft Tissue or Skin threshold range, e.g., -700 to 225 HU, or manually adjust to capture the external skin).
2. Generate a 3D surface from this mask.
3. Export the 3D surface as a PLY (Polygon File Format) file to `/home/ga/Documents/skin_surface.ply`.

Ensure the exported file contains the facial geometry.
